title: Compliance Request Orchestration: Dynamic Forms, DPA Assembly, and Audit-Ready Bundles
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Enable a single orchestration flow that accepts incoming customer compliance requests (questionnaires, DPA clarifications, audit evidence requests) and produces a versioned, exportable audit bundle. Core capabilities: (1) dynamic, templated forms that adapt to customer profile and previous responses; (2) automated DPA clause assembler that pulls contract metadata and creates a customer-ready DPA excerpt; (3) evidence bundling with residency and retention annotations and signed integrity hashes for export. This reduces manual triage time for Customer Success and Legal, speeds audit response SLAs, and provides a machine-readable trail for post-mortem and compliance reporting.
acceptance_criteria: Submit endpoint accepts a compliance request and returns a tracking id within 2s
Dynamic form templates render with customer-specific residency/retention fields and pre-fill from account metadata
DPA assembler generates a PDF excerpt containing correct customer company name, region-residency clause, and KMS key id when present
Audit bundle export includes: request metadata, rendered form responses, exported logs (last 90 days), residency tags, retention policy at time of request, and SHA256 manifest
Admins can download a ZIP bundle and see a timeline of automated steps in Console
Automated triage reduces manual intake steps by >=60% in pilot group
tasks: Design dynamic form schema and templating language (DES-4412)
Backend: create compliance-request API, queueing, and tracking (ENG-9023)
Backend: DPA clause assembler service to read contract metadata and produce PDFs
Console UI: request intake flow, timeline, and bundle download
Retention/residency annotation pipeline: tag artifacts at generation time
Integrations: GitHub PR for export lambda, Confluence runbook for CS playbook
Pilot run with 3 enterprise customers and collect SLA metrics

decision_log: 2025-02-19 - Decision: Use templated Markdown for dynamic form rendering rather than a full WYSIWYG to simplify storage and diffing.
2025-02-22 - Decision: Retention annotations will reference a policy id string and human-readable summary; full policy object will be included in bundle for auditability.
2025-02-25 - Trade-off: Opted to generate DPA excerpts server-side to ensure canonical contract text; increases backend complexity but reduces legal review cycles.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Sensitive data could be pulled into bundles accidentally. Mitigation: enforce field-level allowlist and automatic redaction for PHI/PCI by default.
Risk: Large bundles may exceed storage/transfer limits. Mitigation: stream bundle creation, include pointers to logs with signed URLs and summarize large artifacts in manifest.
Risk: Contract versions mismatch. Mitigation: assembler reads authoritative contract store and embeds contract hash and last-modified timestamp.
metrics_to_track: Mean time to first response (MTTR) for compliance requests
% of requests completed without manual legal review
Average bundle size and generation time
